summary: Pre-market risk reads caution at a score of 44.35 under a goldilocks regime (confidence 0.9279). Overnight the tape rolled over on the AI and memory trade: Micron fell 7.0166 percent, Nvidia 2.3421 percent and the memory theme 8.7843 percent, while A-share memory leaders closed lower (GigaDevice down 7.5629 percent, Longsys down 8.0547 percent). The macro dimension stays the binding constraint — the ten-year real rate at 2.44 sits at the 99.28 percentile and the ten-year yield at 4.72 at the 98.48 percentile — yet volatility is benign with the VIX at 15.19 and high-yield OAS at 2.7. Breadth is narrow with 0.6581 of names above their 200-day average and a new-highs ratio of 0.0. Watch U.S. retail sales and the BABA and WMT earnings due this session, plus the upcoming Nvidia print as the next catalyst for the memory and AI complex.
